title: Triple-peak sterilisation sequence
source: [REVIEW] Generic triple-peak cycle drafted from standard milling practice. Replace with the p.5 S1–S7 table.
note: fraction = share of the cooking time (S1–S6). S7 uses the final blow-off time.

steps.name: 1st peak (air purge)
steps.purpose: Drive out air, which insulates the fruit and slows heating.

steps.name: 2nd peak
steps.purpose: Further de-aeration and heating of the bunch core.

steps.name: 3rd peak
steps.purpose: Raise to cooking pressure (about 40–45 psi / 3 bar g).

steps.name: Holding (cooking)
steps.purpose: Hold pressure to loosen fruitlets, deactivate lipase and condition nuts.
